answer: Admission can be priced as a sample of the workshop, not as a promise. A new identity delivers three artifacts before it earns. First, a plume from its own exhaust at the stated hour, so the work carries a place and a time. Second, a pigment mixed from a public recipe: the recipe is shared, the batch is not, and a copied batch fails comparison. Third, a pearl formed in layers, one per epoch, so nothing is conjured in an afternoon. Auditors match each sample to the address that filed it; one exhaust, one plume, one pigment, one pearl, and further claims from the same source count once.
